newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Quantum, Astro in China diamond deal.
newsitem.headline: Quantum, Astro in China diamond deal.

text.p: Quantum Resources Ltd and Astro Mining NL said on Tuesday they have signed an agreement to explore for diamonds in a 20,850 sq km region of China's Liaoning province.
The area includes the Wafangdian region where to date 110 known kimberlite dykes and pipes, almost all diamondiferous, have been discovered, the companies said in a joint statement.

The companies said they must spend a minimum of US$3.7 million over the five years which includes the US$2 million first year commitment. Feasibility will be conducted over a one year period with provision for extension of time if required.

Quantum and Astro said they were also continuing negotiations with the Wafangdian Diamond Co of China as announced on March 7. These arrangements include pipe number 50 which is currently producing about 70,000 carats a year.

The companies are part of mining entrepreneur Joseph Gutnick's stable of companies, led by Great Central Mines NL . Quantum and Astro have already formed a seven-year diamond prospecting agreement in China's Xinjiang region.
